Exciting Basket.name: Double Dribble
Exciting Basket.summary: The NES port of Double Dribble, the second basketball arcade game by Konami, following Super Basketball.

Hikaru Genji - Roller Panic.name: Hikaru Genji: Roller Panic
Hikaru Genji - Roller Panic.summary: J-pop boy band Hikaru Genji always perform on roller skates, but on the day of their performance at Tokyo Dome (in all but name), the band's roller skates have all been stolen. In this Japanese-style adventure game, you play as a fan of Hikaru Genji who volunteered to help them find the skate thieves and retrieve the band's skates.

Tobidase Daisakusen.name: 3-D WorldRunner
Tobidase Daisakusen.summary: The battle of a lifetime comes alive in 3-D! The wildest of the space cowboys is out looking for adventure. Now he's got it and he needs your help. A strange world terrorized by Grax, the Alien Serpentbeast, has asked you, Worldrunner, for help. Knowing you can outrun, outjump and outblast anyone or anything, you race into battle. But this is no ordinary fight. These battles will carry you to eight strange planets filled with bottomless pits, shooting stars, and poisonous aliens, all sworn to defend their Serpent King. And each new world is ruled by an Alien Serpentbeast more terrifying and more powerful than anything you've ever seen before. Are you ready, Worldrunner? They're waiting for you!
